title: WorkerRequest
description: Core-authorized Worker execution request. Authorization, budget, and targeting are first-class. Extensible arguments MUST NOT carry policy, authorization, Evidence, Finding, Approval, or budget truth. side_effect_level 3 is representable and denied by default in Core; this field is not policy.

contract_version.description: Worker contract major. Not a domain lifecycle version.

worker_capability.description: Capability name from the Tools contract (not a vendor product).

target_reference.description: Opaque target reference already covered by the referenced Core decision. Not a scope grant.

authorization_decision_reference.description: Opaque reference to a Core authorization decision. This field is not the decision document.

side_effect_level.description: 0 read-only/low, 1 minor/reversible, 2 approval-sensitive external state change, 3 destructive/high-impact (denied by default in Core).

secret_references.description: Minimum SecretReferences for this job. No secret values.

arguments.description: Job-specific extensible payload. MUST NOT embed authorization, budget authority, approval, scope state, Evidence, Finding, or promotion.

capability_version.description: Capability definition version bound at compile time. Not authorization.

capability_definition_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of allowlisted capability policy fields. Not authorization.
